items.title: 'Excellent Dundee United showed hunger at St Mirren'
items.summary: Sportscene host Steven Thompson and analyst James McFadden assess Dundee United's 3-0 win at St Mirren.

items.title: Watch: Dundee United overwhelm hosts St Mirren
items.summary: Dundee United score three first-half goals to secure a Scottish Premiership win in Paisley.

items.title: Watch: Hearts recover to draw with Kilmarnock
items.summary: Hearts recover from a disallowed first-half goal and a concession to draw with hosts Kilmarnock in the Scottish Premiership.

items.title: Goodwin in 'good health' but needs 'simple procedure'
items.summary: Dundee United manager Jim Goodwin is not for going into detail about his recent hospital scare that requires "a simple procedure" but is "pleased to say I am back to full health and raring to go" after a three-game absence from the dugout.

items.title: Goodwin to resume Dundee Utd duties after three-week absence
items.summary: Dundee United manager Jim Goodwin is set to resume his duties at Tannadice after an enforced medical absence.

items.title: Goodwin leaves hospital but still absent from United
items.summary: Dundee United manager Jim Goodwin has been released from hospital after a health scare but it remains unclear when he will resume his duties.

items.title: Dundee United's Ferry similar to Celtic's Tierney - Brown
items.summary: Former Celtic captain Scott Brown likens Dundee United left-back Will Ferry to Kieran Tierney, and says Ferry would be a good capture for Celtic.
